# owner: platform
"""Find the stretches of opening hours nobody is covering."""

import hourglass.parsing
import hourglass.models
import hourglass.merging
import hourglass.errors


class OutsideHoursError(hourglass.errors.ProjectError):
    """A worked span falls outside the opening hours."""


# ---
def find_gaps(spans, opening):
    """One label per uncovered stretch, e.g. gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min).

    Raises OutsideHoursError if any span leaves the opening hours.
    """
    spans = list(spans)
    # Every worked span must sit fully inside opening hours.
    for span in spans:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            raise OutsideHoursError(
                "outside opening hours: "
                + hourglass.parsing.format_span(span)
            )

    labels = []
    cursor = opening.start
    # Walk the merged cover, recording the space before each piece.
    for span in hourglass.merging.merge_spans(spans):
        if span.start > cursor:
            labels.append(_label(cursor, span.start))
        cursor = span.end
    if cursor < opening.end:
        labels.append(_label(cursor, opening.end))
    return labels


def _label(start, end):
    gap = hourglass.models.Span(start, end)
    text = hourglass.parsing.format_span(gap)
    return f"gap {text} ({gap.minutes} min)"
EOF
cat > tests/test_gaps.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

import hourglass.models
import hourglass.gaps


def span(start, end):
    return hourglass.models.Span(start * 60, end * 60)


class FindGapsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_in_the_middle(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(
            [span(9, 12), span(13, 17)], span(9, 17)
        )
        self.assertEqual(found, ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_gaps_at_both_ends(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(
            [span(10, 11)], span(9, 12)
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            found,
            ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)", "gap 11:00-12:00 (60 min)"],
        )

    def test_overlaps_leave_no_gap(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps(
            [span(9, 13), span(12, 17)], span(9, 17)
        )
        self.assertEqual(found, [])

    def test_nobody_working(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.find_gaps([], span(9, 10))
        self.assertEqual(found, ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_outside_opening_hours_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(hourglass.gaps.OutsideHoursError):
            hourglass.gaps.find_gaps([span(8, 10)], span(9, 17))
        with self.assertRaises(hourglass.gaps.OutsideHoursError):
            hourglass.gaps.find_gaps([span(16, 18)], span(9, 17))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
